relationships.subject: suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: It works by selectively inhibiting NaV1.8 voltage-gated sodium channels, which play a key role in pain transmission through peripheral sensory neurons.

key_findings: Suzetrigine, an oral selective NaV1.8 inhibitor, was approved in January 2025 for moderate-to-severe acute pain.
Clinical trials showed reduced pain intensity after surgery, offering an opioid alternative.
